## Overview

First-party list of supported issue trackers: Jira, GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps/TFS, Micro Focus ALM, ServiceNow ITSM, Rally and Digital.ai Agility. It also documents a Remote Integration Agent for on-site deployments.

| Axis | Rating | Why |

| Cryptography | none | Not cryptographic guidance. |
| This project | core | Informs workflow integration requirements. |

Bears on DEC-003, DEC-006 and R-021.
